title: Identity-pair normalization of system direct-image composition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $o$ be an Operations package and $c$ its Compositors [def-sf-integral-system-operations], and let $b$ be its section-normalized CanonicalBridge [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Write $S_f=o.\mathrm{push}(f)$ on the derived category of the coefficient-sequence ringed site and $c_{g,f}:S_gS_f\simeq S_{gf}$ for the specified adjunction-conjugate direct-image compositor. For every scheme $X$ and every system object $M$ on $X$, the component of $c_{1_X,1_X}$, followed by equality transport along $1_X1_X=1_X$, equals $S_{1_X}(u_X(M))$. Here $u_X:S_{1_X}\simeq\mathrm{id}$ is exactly the canonical bridge $b.\mathrm{push}(1_X)$ followed by the intrinsic semilinear direct-image identity comparison sId [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons]. The equality is in the entire derived system category and imposes no constructibility, Tor, origin, or finite-field hypothesis.

proof.text: On ordinary coefficient systems evaluate the compositor at every section (n,U). The sections normalization of Compositors and the sectionwise identity normalization of CanonicalBridge identify the two-identity composition map with ordinary direct image of the identity comparison. This is the identity case of the canonical pullback-of-site composition formula. Empty schemes give the same equality on their unique sections.

proof.text: Conjugate under the ordinary inverse-image adjunctions, localize whole complexes, and use pullComp_model to identify the resulting derived pullback comparison with c.pullComp. The uniqueness of transformations out of a localization makes this an equality on the full system derived category, not an inference from finite evaluations.

proof.text: Take right-adjoint conjugates. The mate of the normalized identity comparison is b.push followed by the intrinsic semilinear sId. The mate composition identities identify c.pushComp at the identity pair with its component on S_id M. Naturality of u_X at u_X(M), and cancellation of u_X(M), identify this component with S_id(u_X(M)); insert the equality transport along id_comp.

theorem systemPushIdentityPair (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : System l E X) :
      (c.pushComp l E (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).hom.app M ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun k ↦ (Operations.push l E o k).obj M)
            (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X))) =
        (Operations.push l E o (𝟙 X)).map
          ((b.push l E (𝟙 X) ≪≫
            ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.sId (scalarRings l E)
              (scalarTransitions l E) X).hom.app M)
